proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure applied to the holding in any calendar year does not exceed 170 kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares.
label: Annual nitrogen limit from livestock manure
short_name: occupier of a holding must ensure that total nitrogen in livestock manure applied does not exceed
action: must ensure that total nitrogen in livestock manure applied does not exceed
conditions: nitrogen applied whether directly by an animal or by spreading
affected_subjects: 170 kg per hectare of the holding per calendar year
notes: Core substantive obligation establishing the annual nitrogen limit per hectare from livestock manure.
review_notes: Core substantive obligation establishing the annual nitrogen limit per hectare from livestock manure.

proposition_text: In calculating the area of a holding for nitrogen spreading purposes, no account is to be taken of surface waters, hardstanding, buildings, roads or woodland (unless the woodland is used for grazing).
